title: Project Manager – CBG Plants | Bio-CNG
description:
**Hiring: Project Manager – CBG Plants \| Bio\-CNG**

**Position:** Project Manager – CBG Plants  
**Industry:** Compressed Biogas (CBG) / Renewable Energy / Waste\-to\-Energy  
**Technology Focus:** Modular Dry Plug Flow Compressed Biogas Technology  
**Experience:** 8–15 Years  
**Location:** Prahaladnagar, Ahmedabad  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager – CBG Plants** to lead the planning, execution, commissioning, and successful completion of Compressed Biogas projects based on **Modular Dry Plug Flow technology**.

The candidate will be responsible for managing projects from engineering and procurement through construction, installation, commissioning, performance testing, and handover, while ensuring adherence to project timelines, quality, safety, and budget.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of **CBG / Biogas Plant projects** from project kick\-off to successful commissioning and handover.
* Plan and manage project schedules, milestones, manpower, resources, and budgets.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, electrical, instrumentation, commissioning, and operations teams.
* Manage installation and commissioning of **Modular Dry Plug Flow digesters and associated CBG plant systems**.
* Review and coordinate engineering drawings, P\&IDs, layouts, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate procurement, vendors, contractors, subcontractors, and technology partners.
* Monitor civil, mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation, and process\-related works at project sites.
* Conduct regular site inspections and ensure work is progressing according to approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
* Identify project risks, technical issues, delays, and resource constraints and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure proper coordination between the client, consultants, EPC contractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Monitor project costs and ensure execution within the approved project budget.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **safety, environmental, quality, and statutory requirements**.
* Lead pre\-commissioning, commissioning, performance testing, trial runs, and plant stabilization.
* Coordinate with the operations team during start\-up and ensure proper handover of the plant.
* Prepare and maintain project reports, progress reports, MIS, schedules, inspection reports, and commissioning documentation.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical and commercial issues affecting project execution.
* Support customer meetings and provide technical updates on project progress.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in **Mechanical / Chemical / Civil / Electrical Engineering** or a related discipline.
* 8–15 years of relevant experience in **CBG, biogas, biomethanation, waste\-to\-energy, EPC, or industrial process plant projects**.
* Strong experience in **project execution, site management, commissioning, and contractor management**.
* Experience in anaerobic digestion / biomethanation projects will be highly preferred.
* Knowledge of **CBG plant process systems, digesters, gas purification/upgrading, compression, biogas handling, slurry/digestate management**, and associated utilities will be an advantage.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering and construction teams.
* Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, budgeting, procurement, and quality control.
* Experience with MS Project / Primavera or similar project\-management tools will be an advantage.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Willingness to travel and stay at project sites across India as required.

**Key Skills**

**CBG Plants \| Biogas \| Biomethanation \| Anaerobic Digestion \| Modular Dry Plug Flow Technology \| EPC Projects \| Project Management \| Site Execution \| Commissioning \| Mechanical \& Civil Coordination \| Piping \| Electrical \& Instrumentation \| Vendor Management \| Contractor Management \| Project Scheduling \| Cost Control \| Quality \& Safety**

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On\-time project completion
* Project cost control
* Quality of execution
* Successful commissioning and plant stabilization
* Safety performance
* Vendor and contractor performance
* Customer satisfaction
* Achievement of project milestones

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager, Project & Engineering
description:
Please find the job description for the role discussed  



Job Location: Pipan Plant, Ahmedabad


Role: Project Lead  



**Role Purpose**

Lead the **engineering and execution of a greenfield biosimilars manufacturing facility** , covering conceptual design, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, and handover to operations.


The role will have overall engineering ownership for **facility, process systems, utilities, equipment, HVAC, automation, electrical, civil/structural, and infrastructure** , ensuring the project meets approved scope, schedule, CAPEX, GMP, EHS, quality, and regulatory requirements.  



**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Engineering Project Leadership**

* Lead all engineering activities for the greenfield biosimilars facility from **concept design through commissioning and handover** .
* Develop the engineering execution strategy, project organization, deliverables, schedules, and resource requirements.
* Establish and manage engineering **scope, budget, schedule, interfaces, risks, and technical deliverables** .
* Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams and ensure timely resolution of technical issues.
* Lead technical reviews, design reviews, HAZOP/HAZID, constructability reviews, value engineering, and design optimization.

**2\. Facility \& Process Engineering**

* Drive development of **facility layouts, process flows, material/personnel flows, zoning, segregation, and cleanroom concepts** .
* Ensure facility design supports biosimilar manufacturing requirements, including:
	+ Upstream processing
	+ Downstream processing
	+ Buffer/media preparation
	+ Formulation
	+ Drug substance/drug product areas, as applicable
	+ Sampling and dispensing
	+ Cold rooms/freezers
	+ Warehousing
	+ QC laboratories
* Review and approve **URS, FRS, process descriptions, PFDs, P\&IDs, equipment specifications, and engineering drawings** .
* Ensure design incorporates appropriate future expansion and capacity requirements.

**3\. Utilities \& Infrastructure**

Provide engineering oversight for critical GMP and non\-GMP utilities, including:


* Purified Water / WFI systems
* Clean steam
* Process gases and compressed air
* HVAC and cleanroom systems
* Chilled water and cooling systems
* Boilers and hot\-water systems
* Nitrogen and other specialty gases
* Electrical distribution and backup power
* Building management systems
* Effluent and waste\-treatment systems
* Fire protection systems
* Plant and site infrastructure

**4\. Equipment Engineering \& Procurement**

* Lead selection, specification, technical evaluation, and procurement of major process and utility equipment.
* Review vendor proposals and participate in **technical bid evaluations** .
* Manage equipment design reviews, **FAT/SAT** , vendor documentation, and installation requirements.
* Ensure equipment selection meets GMP, maintainability, safety, reliability, and lifecycle\-cost requirements.
* Coordinate integration of **single\-use and stainless\-steel technologies** , as applicable.

**5\. EPC / EPCM \& Contractor Management**

* Manage EPC/EPCM consultants, engineering contractors, construction contractors, and equipment vendors.
* Review engineering deliverables and ensure compliance with approved design standards.
* Monitor contractor performance against **scope, schedule, quality, and cost** .
* Lead technical and commercial discussions related to engineering changes and contractor claims.
* Ensure effective interface management between engineering disciplines and construction teams.

**6\. Automation \& Digital Systems**

* Provide engineering leadership for **BMS, EMS, SCADA, DCS/PLC, process automation, and facility monitoring systems** .
* Ensure appropriate integration between process equipment and site automation systems.
* Coordinate with IT/CSV teams for computerized\-system requirements and GMP compliance.
* Support implementation of data\-integrity and electronic\-record requirements.

**7\. Construction, Commissioning \& Qualification**

* Provide engineering leadership throughout construction and installation.
* Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, GMP requirements, and EHS standards.
* Lead construction punch\-list closure and technical issue resolution.
* Coordinate **commissioning, qualification, and validation** activities with CQV, QA, Engineering, and Operations.
* Ensure readiness of systems for **IQ/OQ/PQ and process qualification** , as applicable.
* Drive engineering handover and preparation of final documentation/as\-built drawings.

**8\. GMP \& Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure engineering design complies with applicable **cGMP, GEP, GxP, EHS, and regulatory requirements** .
* Incorporate relevant requirements from **US FDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO, PIC/S, ISPE, and applicable local regulations** .
* Participate in regulatory inspection preparation and provide engineering support during inspections.
* Ensure appropriate engineering documentation, traceability, change control, and deviation management.

**9\. Project Controls \& Governance**

* Develop and maintain the **engineering master schedule** and critical\-path activities.
* Track engineering progress, procurement milestones, construction progress, and commissioning readiness.
* Manage engineering CAPEX and identify cost\-saving/value\-engineering opportunities.
* Establish project KPIs and provide regular reporting to senior management.
* Proactively identify and mitigate technical and execution risks.

  
**Education:** B.E/ B. Tech (Mechanical/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Instrumentation)

title: Project Manager
description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.



For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.



\#


### **Senior Project Manager – HVAC (Chillers)**


**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat **Department:** Operations / Project Management **Experience:** 12\-18 Years **Industry:** HVAC, Building Solutions, Chillers, MEP Projects


### **Job Summary**



We are seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager \- HVAC** to lead and manage end\-to\-end execution of large\-scale HVAC and Chiller projects. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in **HVAC systems, Chillers, project execution, project management, stakeholder management, and commercial aspects of projects**. The role requires ensuring timely project delivery, quality compliance, customer satisfaction, and profitability.


### **Key Responsibilities**


### **Project Management \& Execution**


* Lead multiple HVAC and Chiller projects from initiation to commissioning and handover.
* Develop project execution plans, schedules, resource allocation plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and as per contractual requirements.
* Monitor project progress and resolve technical, commercial, and operational issues.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

### **Technical Management**


* Oversee installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of HVAC and Chiller systems.
* Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with HVAC industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements.
* Provide technical guidance to project engineers and site teams.

### **Customer \& Stakeholder Management**


* Act as the primary point of contact for customers, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Manage client expectations, change requests, and escalation handling.

### **Commercial \& Financial Management**


* Monitor project budgets, costs, cash flow, and profitability.
* Review project variations, claims, and billing milestones.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and project closure.

### **Team Leadership**


* Lead and mentor project managers, engineers, and site execution teams.
* Drive performance, productivity, and accountability across project teams.
* Promote a culture of safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

### **EHS \& Quality Compliance**


* Ensure adherence to EHS standards and organizational safety policies.
* Drive quality control processes throughout project execution.
* Conduct audits and corrective actions to ensure compliance.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* PMP/Prince2 certification will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of HVAC systems, Chillers, Air Handling Units (AHU), Cooling Towers, Pumps, and Building Automation Systems.

### **Required Experience**


* 12\-18 years of experience in HVAC/Chiller project execution and project management.
* Proven track record of managing large commercial, industrial, healthcare, pharmaceutical, data center, or infrastructure projects.
* Hands\-on experience in Chiller installation, commissioning, and lifecycle project management.
* Experience managing project teams, contractors, consultants, and customers.

### **Key Skills**


* HVAC Project Management
* Chiller Systems
* Project Execution
* Project Planning \& Scheduling
* Contract Management
* Cost Control \& Budgeting
* Stakeholder Management
* Risk Management
* Installation \& Commissioning
* MEP Projects
* EHS Compliance
* Team Leadership
* Customer Relationship Management

### **Preferred Industry Background**



Candidates from HVAC, Building Technologies, MEP Contracting, Chiller Manufacturing, Industrial Cooling, Data Centers, Pharmaceuticals, Commercial Buildings, or Infrastructure Projects will be preferred.
